content: sharp ships prebuilt libvips binaries per-platform (@img/sharp-libvips-linuxmusl-x64 etc.) that install automatically on node:24-alpine (musl) x64/arm64 without a native build step — matches this project's existing node:24-alpine Dockerfile base. No apk packages needed for basic PNG/SVG compositing. sharp engines require node >=20.9.0, satisfied by Node 24.
